newsitem.title: USA: WinStar to buy 15 more wireless licenses.
newsitem.headline: WinStar to buy 15 more wireless licenses.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc on Tuesday said it had definitive agreements to acquire 15 more wireless licenses in the 38-gigahertz (GHz) radio spectrum.
WinStar said that the acquisitions would add a new channel in Cincinnati, Detroit, Los Angeles, Minneapolis, Nashville and Phoenix, where the company already operates.
The licenses, currently held by several parties, will expand WinStar's channel coverage in 13 markets and add two markets to WinStar's operating territories.
The acquisitions are subject to approval by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission.
The company provides its Wireless Fiber services using its licenses in the 38 GHz spectrum. It also provides long-distance services, information services and entertainment content.
